 NFL News Roundup NFL news roundup: Rams LB Myles Garrett will practice this week; Daniel Jones to start Week 9
 Published: Updated: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL. Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown. 
 Arizona Cardinals 3-5 INJURIES 
 RB Jeremiyah Love is dealing with a new ankle injury following Sunday's win, head coach Mike LaFleur said. LaFleur added he will have an update on Love later this week.
 WR  Kendrick Bourne will be out for the rest of the season after suffering a fractured tibia, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported. Schefter added that Bourne won't require surgery but is expected to miss about months.
 DEPTH CHART NEWS 
 QB Gardner Minshew will start Arizona's Week 9 game against the Seahawks, LaFleur said. Rookie Carson Beck will be the team's backup QB, LaFleur added. Minshew replaced Jacoby Brissett under center in the second half of Sunday's win over the Cowboys.
 Atlanta Falcons 3-5 INJURIES 
 WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring) won't play in Atlanta's Week 9 game against Bengals in Madrid, coach Kevin Stefanski said.
 DE Samson Ebukam (hamstring) won't play against the Bengals, per Stefanski.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 DE  Drake Jackson 
 LB Jared Ivey 
 SUSPENSIONS 
 DE James Pearce Jr. was reinstated by the league after completing his eight-game suspension for violating the personal conduct policy. Pearce is now eligible to play Week 9 against the Bengals. Pearce has a roster exemption that will expire on Nov. 9.
 Baltimore Ravens 4-4 SIGNINGS 
 QB Austin Reed (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 FB Lucas Scott (practice squad)
 INJURIES 
 QB Joe Fagnano is working through some things physically but has a chance to play Thursday against the Jaguars, head coach Jesse Minter said. Fagnano (ankle) was estimated as a limited participant after Monday's walkthrough.
 QB Tyler Huntley (toe) is unlikely to play Thursday, Minter said. Huntley was estimated as a non-participant after Monday's walkthrough.
 RB Justice Hill (groin) limited
 RB Adam Randall (neck) was estimated as a full participant.
 TE Mark Andrews (hand) full
 TE Matthew Hibner (hand) full
 G Olaivavega Ioane (knee) limited
 G John Simpson (back) limited
 OT Roger Rosengarten (ankle) limited
 OT Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) limited
 LB Trey Hendrickson (finger/ribs) limited
 LB Roquan Smith (foot) limited
 CB Nate Wiggins (stinger) full
 S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) DNP
 K Tyler Loop (right groin) could potentially go on injured reserve, said Minter, who told reporters that  Jake Moody is in line to replace him on Thursday "at this point." Loop was estimated as a non-participant following Monday's walkthrough.
 Buffalo Bills 6-1 SUSPENSIONS 
 DB Chauncey Gardner-Johnson was reinstated by the league after serving his one-game suspension for unsportsmanlike conduct during Buffalo's Week 6 win over the Raiders. Gardner-Johnson has a roster exemption that will expire on Nov. 3.
 Carolina Panthers 3-4 
 HIRES 
 DeAngelo Hall was hired as Carolina's cornerbacks coach. Hall, a former three-time Pro Bowl CB, served as assistant defensive backs coach with the Panthers from 2023-24. Hall's hire comes after Carolina fired defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero and defensive passing game coordinator Jonathan Cooley.
 SIGNINGS 
 LB Mohamoud Diabate (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 LB Maema Njongmeta 
 Chicago Bears 5-2 INJURIES 
 DT Grady Jarrett suffered a groin injury and left in the fourth quarter of Monday night's game against the Seahawks.
 DT  Kentavius Street  left Monday night's game with a knee injury. 
 GAME DAY ELEVATIONS 
 TE Stephen Carlson 
 Cincinnati Bengals 5-2 INJURIES 
 DE Cashius Howell will be out "weeks" after undergoing wrist surgery and is "trending" toward being placed on injured reserve, coach Zac Taylor said.
 DE Cedric Johnson (ankle) is day to day, Taylor said.
 CB DJ Turner II is day to day with a heel injury, per Taylor.
 Cleveland Browns 5-3 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Audric Estimé 
 Dallas Cowboys 3-5 INJURIES 
 TE Jake Ferguson (ankle) has a chance to play Sunday against the Colts, head coach Brian Schottenheimer said.
 LB  Malachi Lawrence (ankle) could miss a few weeks, Schottenheimer said.
 CB  Caleb Downs is in the concussion protocol, Schottenheimer said.
 S P.J. Locke is in the concussion protocol, Schottenheimer said.
 Detroit Lions 5-2 INJURIES 
 C Cade Mays is dealing with a low ankle sprain, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported. May will be out of practice to start this week, coach Dan Campbell said.
 LB  Jack Campbell (neck) remains in the hospital, and "preliminary indications are positive," the team announced. Campbell stayed at a local hospital overnight after being carted off on a stretcher during Sunday's win over Minnesota.
 LB  Jimmy Rolder (hamstring) will miss the rest of the season, Campbell said.
 Green Bay Packers 5-3 SIGNINGS 
 QB Cam Miller is signing to Green Bay's practice squad, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported.
 INJURIES 
 LB Micah Parsons is expected to practice this week for the first time since he suffered a season-ending knee injury in December 2025, head coach Matt LaFleur said.
 Houston Texans 2-5 SIGNINGS 
 RB Joshua Pitsenberger (practice squad)
 DT Naquan Jones was signed from the 49ers practice squad.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Deuce Vaughn 
 DT Jaden Crumedy 
 Indianapolis Colts 2-6 DEPTH CHART NEWS 
 QB Daniel Jones will start the Colts' Week 9 game against the Cowboys, head coach Shane Steichen said.
 Jacksonville Jaguars 5-2 INJURIES 
 RB Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was estimated as a limited participant after Monday's walkthrough.
 RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) was estimated as a non-participant.
 WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) limited
 OL Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) limited
 DT  DaVon Hamilton suffered a torn quad in Sunday's win over the Colts and will miss the remainder of the season, head coach Liam Coen said.
 DE Travon Walker (rib) DNP
 CB Jarrian Jones (ankle) limited
 S Antonio Johnson (ankle) limited
 S Eric Murray (elbow) is out for the remainder of the season, Coen said.
 SIGNINGS 
 DT Austin Johnson (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 LS Jacob Bobenmoyer 
 Kansas City Chiefs 5-2 ROSTER CUTS 
 DB Kader Kohou (practice squad)
 Los Angeles Chargers 0-7 SIGNINGS 
 DB Jalyn Armour-Davis (practice squad)
 Los Angeles Rams 4-4 INJURIES 
 RB Dean Connors fractured his hand Sunday, will undergo surgery and is a candidate for injured reserve, head coach Sean McVay said.
 TE  Terrance Ferguson , who is currently on injured reserve with an ankle injury, has a good chance to return to practice this week, McVay said.
 LB Myles Garrett (knee) will practice this week and have his 21-day practice window opened to come off injured reserve, McVay said.
 LB Grant Stuard (hamstring) is week to week, McVay said.
 Miami Dolphins 1-6 ROSTER CUTS 
 DE Robert Beal Jr. 
 Minnesota Vikings 6-1 INJURIES 
 QB Kyler Murray is dealing with a "sore" hamstring following the Vikings' loss to the Lions on Sunday, head coach Kevin O'Connell said. Minnesota faces the Bills on "Monday Night Football" in Week 9, and O'Connell said it is too early to speculate on Murray's availability for that game, per ESPN.com .
 LT Christian Darrisaw is dealing with shoulder soreness, per O'Connell.
 S Theo Jackson is dealing with quadricep soreness, O'Connell said.
 New England Patriots 5-3 SIGNINGS 
 RB Terrell Jennings (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 S Elliott Davison (practice squad)
 New Orleans Saints 2-5 FIRINGS 
 Offensive run game coordinator T.J Paganetti was fired amid a 2-5 start, coach Kellen Moore confirmed Monday. NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport first reported the news. Offensive line coach Brendan Nugent will lead the run game in place of Paganetti, Moore added. Paganetti was in his second season in New Orleans. The Saints are 28th in the NFL in rushing yards per game (86.0) and 30th in rushing yards per play (3.52).
 New York Giants 4-2-1 SIGNINGS 
 RB Eric Gray (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 NT Josh Tupou (practice squad)
 San Francisco 49ers 6-1 SIGNINGS 
 WR KhaDarel Hodge (practice squad)
 Seattle Seahawks 4-3 INJURIES 
 RB Jadarian Price (chest) was activated off injured reserve ahead of Monday night's game against the Bears.
 DT Leonard Williams (stinger) left in the third quarter on Monday night. 
 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Robert Henry Jr. 
 GAME DAY ELEVATIONS 
 WR Montorie Foster Jr 
 OT Bobby Hart 
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 3-5 INJURIES 
 OLB YaYa Diaby suffered a Grade 2 MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Atlanta and will miss time, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported. Coach Todd Bowles confirmed the nature of Diaby's injury and was hopeful that he would not need to be placed on injured reserve, which would force Diaby to miss at least four games.
 Washington Commanders 2-4-1 INJURIES 
 RB Jeremy McNichols is dealing with a mid-foot injury that is believed to be "serious," coach Dan Quinn said.
